Bulimia, on the other hand, involves bingeing and purging of food, which can result in significant weight gain and excessive calorie intake. Individuals with bulimia may experience feelings of shame and guilt, leading them to engage in harmful behaviors such as vomiting, overeating, or using laxatives or diuretics to remove excess water from their body.
